verdict.rationale: Floot exposes a rich MCP tool surface (get_logs, query_database, execute_sql, create_checkpoint, generate_image, etc.) that lets an AI assistant perform many actions equivalent to the UI, but this is a curated tool set rather than a full API mirroring all UI capabilities, and no general-purpose REST/OpenAPI API was found (openapi.json/docs.md probes 404). missing for 10: a documented general API or OpenAPI spec covering all UI actions (e.g., custom domains, mobile app publishing, sharing/collaborator management), and independent confirmation that MCP tools cover 100% of UI functionality rather than a subset.
